name: Mizushima Serika
source:
Serika is another childhood friend of [url=/c728]Shinichi[/url] and they’re also classmates. She is a tsundere and can be quite reckless sometimes, she also has an incredibly fierce rivalry of [url=/c1464]Miyuri[/url] and gets jealous of [url=/c733]Kyoko’s[/url] maid outfit in Cafe Sourire. In all honestly, she’s had feelings for Shinichi since they were just children.

[From [url=http://liemyx.wordpress.com/2011/09/27/cafe-sourire-review/]Liemyx's review[/url].]
